name: Bell Pepper (Yellow)
siboNotes: Yellow bell peppers are well-tolerated and provide beneficial nutrients without feeding bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Remove seeds and white pith for easier digestion
Can be eaten raw or cooked - cooking may improve tolerance for sensitive individuals
Roasting enhances sweetness and makes them more digestible
Store in refrigerator for up to 1 week for optimal freshness
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C (more than oranges)
Rich in vitamin A and beta-carotene
Good source of folate and potassium
